reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Cilium Operator now uses dynamic rate limiting based on cluster size for the CiliumEndpointSlice controller", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The ces-write-qps-limit flag value is ignored; the operator uses dynamic rate limiting instead.

proposed.statement: The Cilium Operator's six CiliumEndpointSlice rate limit flags (ces-write-qps-limit, ces-write-qps-burst, ces-enable-dynamic-rate-limit, ces-dynamic-rate-limit-nodes, ces-dynamic-rate-limit-qps-limit, ces-dynamic-rate-limit-qps-burst) are deprecated and their usage is now ignored; the ces-rate-limits flag or ciliumEndpointSlice.rateLimits Helm value replaces them.
